Chapter 968  Chapter 25: The Light Boat Has Crossed Ten Thousand Mountains (Please Subscribe)

Cosmic Starry Skies.

Lin Yuan's soul will returns.

Soon after, a transformative upheaval occurs within him.

In the ultimate leap, Lin Yuan escapes from the Demon Heart World.

It seemed as though aeons had passed in the Cosmic Era, yet in the outside world, only a dozen breaths of time had gone by.

In those dozen breaths, Lin Yuan's flesh, soul, and even the inner cosmos multiplied drastically in strength.

"My flesh body..." Lin Yuan looks at his own hands.

At this moment, every drop of his blood is filled with boundless power; with the sheer strength of his flesh body alone, without relying on any other rules or techniques, he could suppress normal beings of the Path Splitting Realm with his physical might.

Even among the nine supreme beings of human civilization, the Ancient Power Supreme Being, who specialised in the power of the flesh body, surely does not surpass Lin Yuan in this aspect.

This is not to say that the pathway of the Ancient Power Supreme Being is inadequate, but Lin Yuan's foundation is too profound. Enduring an immense amount of Chaos Void Origin, even if only one-tenth was absorbed by the flesh, the enhancement received far exceeds the total benefits of a normal being ascending from Level Eleven Perfect to Level Twelve.

Moreover, apart from the Chaos Void Origin, the benefits from the mysterious gourd, the Xuanhuang Physique, the Demonic Jade Immortal Body, and other aspects, have brought his flesh body to an inconceivable state.

"The Xuanhuang Physique..."

With the life essence completing its transformation and leap, successfully stepping into Level Twelve, the "Xuanhuang Physique" cultivated by Lin Yuan also naturally reached the Level Twelve tier.

Breathe!

Inhale!

Simply by functioning for a short period, Lin Yuan's flesh body strength increased significantly, but soon stopped proceeding.

There's no helping it; the "Xuanhuang Physique" is too terrifying in its devouring of resources. Forget about reaching Level Twelve Perfect, even attaining the Path Splitting Realm Perfect within the cosmos seemed hopeless for Lin Yuan.

"However, the resources for cultivating the 'Xuanhuang Physique' could be obtained from Ancient Ming's Chaos Continent?"

Lin Yuan contemplates to himself.

The cosmic rules restrict any being of Level Twelve from leaving the cosmos; the only possibility is to condense a trivial avatar.

However, cosmic rules don't limit resources from outside the cosmos from entering it.

Lin Yuan could absolutely acquire numerous resources from Ancient Ming's Chaos Continent and then send them back for the true self's cultivation.

As for the means to acquire numerous resources? The simplest way would be to sell the Chaos Realm secret treasure left by the peak Path Splitting Realm being, Cang Weiyang.

A Chaos Realm secret treasure, even if Lin Yuan has stepped into Level Twelve, would be inoperative in the short term; rather than letting it collect dust, it would be better to convert it into strength swiftly.

With the value of a Chaos Realm secret treasure, it would more than suffice for Lin Yuan to cultivate his "Xuanhuang Physique" to the perfection of the Path Splitting Realm.

"Soul strength has also reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm."

Lin Yuan nods slightly, as the soul derives from the will of the flesh and the mind.

After the ultimate leap, stepping into Level Twelve, the soul naturally achieves an upgrade.

"My mental willpower... has reached at least sixty million points," Lin Yuan exhales lightly.

The enhancement of mental willpower is far more difficult than that of the flesh body and soul, especially after reaching the twenty million points index of mental willpower.

On the eleventh traversing, Lin Yuan, in the core of the Immortal Realm's Origin, observed and comprehended the essence of rules for hundreds of years, barely reaching a forty million points index of mental willpower.

An index of forty million points of mental willpower is already at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm. Even many at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm do not possess such formidable mental willpower.

And sixty million points of mental willpower index? That's probably the strength of mental willpower at the peak Dao Realm.

The surge from forty million to sixty million points of mental willpower index far exceeds the normal ascent from Level Eleven Perfect to Level Twelve.

"The Demon Heart World I experienced, its source of power comes from the main artery of the river of time; it is formed according to my own foundation."

Lin Yuan thinks to himself.

In that Demon Heart World, Lin Yuan does not know how many Cosmic Eras he lived through, thousands, tens of thousands? A normal being at Level Eleven Perfect couldn't possibly endure such hellish difficulty.

The only explanation is that the difficulty of the Demon Heart World Lin Yuan faced was intensified.

Of course, an intensified Demon Heart World, once navigated through, comes with tremendous benefits, and the sixty million points of mental willpower are proof of that.

"No wonder it is said that when attempting to reach Level Twelve, even with substantial depth, there is no certainty of success. Other aspects are negotiable, but the Demon Heart World varies for every being at Level Eleven; the stronger the foundation, the more challenging the Demon Heart World."

Lin Yuan muses to himself.

Before experiencing the Demon Heart World, the so-called backlash of the river of time, the so-called cosmic backlash, were like a gentle breeze to Lin Yuan, hardly influencing him at all.

Only when the Demon Heart World arrived did Lin Yuan feel the difficulty.

In that world filled with countless tribulations, Lin Yuan, aside from his memories, was no different from an ordinary person, and even as eons passed, hundreds or thousands of Cosmic Eras later, even his memory began to blur.

Were it not for the unprecedented spread of the Martial Tao pathway, which served as a 'anchor' for Lin Yuan to lock onto himself, navigating through the Demon Heart World would not have been so effortless for him.

"Inner cosmic universe..."

Lin Yuan's consciousness descends into his inner cosmic universe.

At this moment, his inner universe has reached a diameter of two million two hundred thousand light-years.

Before the ultimate leap, Lin Yuan's inner cosmos had only expanded to a fifty-thousand-light-year span.

From fifty thousand to two million two hundred thousand light-years, it appears to have increased merely by four to five times, but the actual volume difference is tens to hundreds of times greater.

"After the ultimate leap, as the inner cosmic universe continues to expand, the ultimate limit size of my inner cosmos should be around eight million light-years in diameter."
